conditions.cold: New unique output path for every process; no resume/cache-hit output. Source/OS caches are retained, not flushed cold.
conditions.order: Independent ABBA/BAAB/ABBA blocks with rotating worker order; fixed sample budget.
conditions.timing: Cook process wall/CPU and cooker elapsed include source decode, build, encode, checkpoint, runtime topology inspection and report work. Separate inspect/all-payload/source-attribute validation is excluded from cook timings and resources.
conditions.correctness: Every output is fully payload-validated, checked against source dependency identity by the cooker, and whole-file SHA256 plus geometry manifest must match across all candidates/workers/repetitions.
conditions.storage: By default retain the first validated reference stream, remove later matching run-owned payloads after cross-candidate validation/hash capture, and preserve every manifest/event/log/resource sample. Failed/mismatching outputs remain. --keep-payloads retains all binaries.
conditions.gpu: CPU-only cooker; no GPU work or measured VRAM. Aligned device payload sizes in manifests are byte accounting, not VRAM measurements.

correctness: All complete stream file hashes and geometry manifests match; every payload decoded successfully
